title: Adversarial multi-fidelity discrepancy diagnostics for casting optimization

design_space.design_generator: Seed-offset deterministic Halton sequence; candidate IDs are shared within a scenario-seed across all fidelity levels.

fidelity_semantics.high: Exact analytic high-fidelity truth at original x.
fidelity_semantics.medium: Scenario-specific discrepancy scaled by 0.38*severity for additive/noise terms, with explicit smaller coordinate warping in warped_coordinates.
fidelity_semantics.low: Full scenario-specific discrepancy at configured severity.
fidelity_semantics.zero_severity_invariant: All fidelity outputs exactly equal the high-fidelity truth when severity=0.

scenarios.failure_mode: Smooth additive objective and constraint bias.
scenarios.purpose: Correlated but biased low-fidelity control case.

scenarios.failure_mode: Localized high-amplitude bias in an input region.
scenarios.purpose: Test local discrepancy that a global correction can miss.
scenarios.island_center: center_i=0.72 if i is even, else 0.28

scenarios.failure_mode: Low/medium evaluator sees a displaced input.
scenarios.low_warp: warp_i=0.15*severity*sin(2*pi*(x_(i+1 mod d)+i/7)) then clamp x_i+warp_i to [0,1]
scenarios.medium_warp: warp_i=0.045*severity*sin(2*pi*(x_(i+1 mod d)+i/7)) then clamp x_i+warp_i to [0,1]
scenarios.additional_bias: f0 += severity*scale*0.025*sin(2*pi*x_0); f1 -= severity*scale*0.02*cos(2*pi*x_last); scale=1 for low, 0.38 for medium

scenarios.failure_mode: Constraint error amplified near feasibility boundary.
scenarios.purpose: Measure false-feasible and false-infeasible labels where decisions are sensitive.

scenarios.failure_mode: Fidelity-specific step thresholds and sign changes.
scenarios.purpose: Probe failure of smooth/global discrepancy corrections across discontinuities.

scenarios.failure_mode: Seed-indexed deterministic perturbations amplify near boundary/domain edges.
scenarios.purpose: Reproducible heteroscedastic stress; not a calibrated stochastic process.

diagnostics: Pairwise objective rank-inversion fraction, computed separately per objective against analytic truth.
Feasibility label flip count and fraction.
False-feasible count and fraction among low/medium predicted-feasible points.
All diagnostics stratified by scenario, dimension, severity, fidelity and seed.

default_sweep.reporting: Preserve all 162 raw scenario runs; report median and interquartile range across three paired seeds for each scenario/dimension/severity/fidelity.

limitations: This is a fidelity diagnostic suite, not an end-to-end optimizer comparison.
No policy, BoTorch baseline, foundry solver or physical casting process is run by this module.
The scenario equations are synthetic controlled stressors, not calibrated physics or foundry cost estimates.
The seed-indexed heteroscedastic term is deterministic conditional on seed and coordinates; it is not a full stochastic replicate model.

A future optimizer bake-off must use fixed, identical candidate pools, objective-call budgets, known reference/ideal conventions, independent trace scoring, and separate reporting for COCO-native metrics.
Scenario families are a challenge taxonomy, not evidence that every real foundry process exhibits these exact discrepancy patterns.
